name: When should I consider replacing old plaster with new drywall?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing old plaster with new drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing old plaster with new drywall if your plaster walls are extensively damaged, crumbling, or show signs of severe cracking that are difficult to repair. Drywall offers a smoother, more uniform surface and is generally easier and more cost-effective to repair in the long term. Replacing plaster can also provide an opportunity to update insulation or address electrical wiring behind the walls, improving overall home efficiency and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing old plaster with drywall if it's extensively damaged, crumbling, or severely cracked, as drywall offers a smoother finish and easier repairs.
